stops.stop: Rehovot, the machine is given the name
stops.date_confidence: Attested to the day: WEIZAC is decommissioned and its successor begins operating on 29 December 1963. Golem B, planned from 1967, runs from 1974, so the 1972 successor sometimes cited does not exist.
